{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000E8GXJHT2A53J9","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram kind=sequence
node Person role=actor
node Chat "Chat" ref="packages/core/compute/assistant/src/types/Chat.ts"
node Agent "Agent process" ref="packages/core/compute/agent-runtime/src/agent-service/agent-process.ts"
node Model "Model" ref="packages/core/compute/ai/src/AiService.ts"
node Space "ECHO objects"
edge Person -> Chat "message"
edge Chat sends Agent "input"
edge Agent calls Model "chat and skills"
edge Model returns Agent "operation call"
fragment loop "until it answers" {
  edge Agent calls Space "invoke operation"
  edge Space returns Agent "result"
  edge Agent calls Model "result"
  edge Model returns Agent "next step"
}
edge Agent -> Chat "answer"
